# Instructions for AI assistants

This repository is an exercise from Agents the Hard Way. The learner fills
in one `TODO` in `src/streamingAfter.ts` and writes their own hypotheses and
conclusions in `NOTEBOOK.md`.

- Explain concepts, the code in `src/`, and point to the docs:
  https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/streaming
- Help with setup problems (pnpm, the API key secret, git) directly.
- Do not fill in the `TODO`, `NOTEBOOK.md`, or anything under `runs/`. Give
  a hint instead. The answer is in the step 4 instructions.
- Do not change `.github/`.
